title: Mexican-Inspired Breakfast Casserole
description: This Mexican-inspired breakfast casserole recipe combines eggs, smoky bacon, red and yellow bell peppers, fresh cilantro, and three types of cheese.
ingredients: 0.25 cup chopped fresh cilantro, or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
0.5 cup croutons, or more to taste
0.5 cup shredded pepper Jack cheese, or more to taste
0.5 cup shredded Cheddar cheese, or more to taste
0.5 cup shredded Swiss cheese, or more to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly coat a square baking pan with cooking spray.
Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Drain on paper towels. Chop when cool enough to handle.
Whisk eggs and milk together in a bowl. Stir in bell peppers, onion, cilantro, salt, and black pepper.
Arrange croutons in the bottom of the prepared pan. Layer bacon, pepper Jack cheese, Cheddar cheese, and Swiss cheese on top, then pour egg mixture over top.
Bake in the preheated oven until set, 30 to 40 minutes. Remove from the oven; let sit before serving for 20 minutes.
